subject: english
stem: What happens next in this passage after “Some did not own smartphones.”?
options: One student said, "My phone is useful, but I do not want it to be my only way to rest."
The student council decided to interview her for the school newspaper.
Patients could check their waiting number on a screen or phone.
One student felt uncomfortable showing his personal phone at the gate.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「One student said, 'My phone is useful, but I do not want it to be my only way…」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「The student council decided to interview her for the school newspaper.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Patients could check their waiting number on a screen or phone.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「Some did not own smartphones. One student felt uncomfortable showing his personal phone at the gate.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
